title: Math Tutoring
description: Weekly one-on-one math tutoring for first-year students. Topics ranged from algebra fundamentals to early calculus. Sessions included worked examples, problem sets, and exam-prep strategies.

title: Beach Cleanup
description: Saturday morning shoreline cleanup along the Corniche. The team collected over 60 kg of plastic and glass waste and sorted it for recycling. Co-led the safety briefing for new volunteers.

title: Hospital Visit
description: Visiting children's ward with art supplies and storybooks. Coordinating with the hospital's community engagement team to plan craft activities tailored to younger patients.

title: Food Bank Sorting
description: Sorted and packed donated food into family-sized boxes for distribution. Helped track inventory in the warehouse system and labelled each parcel by dietary need.

title: Science Fair Mentoring
description: Mentoring high-school teams preparing science fair projects. Will run two workshops on experimental design and a final dry-run for poster presentations.

title: Park Tree Planting
description: Tree-planting drive at Aspire Park. Each volunteer plants and waters two saplings and is paired with a local horticulturist for guidance on long-term care.
